messages.message: The detector's far-field intrinsic efficiency: the chance a gamma striking the detector face is recorded in the full-energy peak. When the detector has a characterized response, the efficiency used to compute the flux comes from that response, so it is not exactly this column times the geometric efficiency - near the detector the flat-disk product is an approximation.

The nominal flat-disk solid-angle fraction the detector face takes up at the given distance. See the note on the intrinsic efficiency column for why the two do not necessarily multiply to the efficiency used.

Distance from center of source to face of detector. Number must be followed by units; valid units are: meters, m, cm, mm, km, feet, ft, ', in, inches, or ". You may also add multiple distances, such as '3ft 4in', or '3.6E-2 m 12 cm' which are equivalent to 40inches and 15.6cm respectively.
